scope: additional visual-review method after the cross-role identity and temporal reviews

method.name: multi-background edge and alpha compositing stress
method.purpose: detect transparent-edge color contamination, hidden opaque backing panels, and display-size silhouette changes that may be missed on a single neutral background
method.selection: alpha-aware edge and palette metrics rank candidates only; normal-size visual review is authoritative

limitations: This is offline raster compositing evidence, not a live Codex App capture.
The method does not prove multi-monitor placement, bubble tracking, or platform-specific compositor behavior.
The authoritative despill report and v2 atlas validator remain the release gates for chroma and structural correctness.
